intelligence.human_view: He has now said it three ways across two calls and a chat: the video is not playing, the images are not showing, the N is not right. Each round that re-places without diagnosing spends his walk on the same failure. The walk is the scarce thing — his eye, his time, his patience. A diagnosed cause, fixed once, costs one walk; an undiagnosed repeat costs a walk every time it is shown.
intelligence.simple_view: Clicking play must do something. Her picture does not go in the player. Her face big in the center does the talking. The little red N at the bottom does the marking. The button says "Let's Go." The video plays first of all.
intelligence.grandma_view: A play button that plays nothing is a broken promise, not a missing feature. A correction that adds is not the same as a correction that restores. A face and a mark are not two decorations competing for the same corner — they are a balance. Her face big in the center does the talking; the little red N at the bottom does the marking.
intelligence.naya_view: A thing that will not play has a reason, and the reason is the work. Re-placing the same video in the same spot and hoping it plays this time is not a fix — it is a repeat with a new timestamp. The diagnosis comes first: what is handed to the build, what the build does with it, where it breaks — named, in order, with proof. Only then does the placement mean anything, because only then can the walk prove it plays.
